== English Decipher comparison ==
The PC state restricts replacement to another male Rodian and applies the power bonus to all your Rodians. The targeting of a smuggler and the 2-point destiny bonus remain. The bronze disc, E slip, E full card, and D-E1 face reproduce one gameplay state.
